definitions.return_and_full_mdd: All existing reference snapshots from window start through end_exclusive minus5minutes; hypothetical remaining exit cost already reserved.
definitions.drawdown_duration: Latest preceding observed high-water timestamp to recovery or last observed endpoint; unrecovered episodes right-censored; not tick-level duration.
definitions.daily: Consecutive observed UTC00 snapshots only; final00:00-to23:55 partial day excluded from ratios/CAGR/Calmar.
definitions.weekly: Complete Monday00-to-Monday00 UTC intervals only, no partial boundary week.
definitions.calmar: Geometric365-day annualized growth from first/last complete daily endpoints divided by5-minute reference MDD within those same endpoints. Zero MDD =>null.
definitions.fees: Frozen commission plus execution proxy, applied once at entry; terminal exit cost is a hypothetical reserve, not a natural exit.
definitions.funding: Actual historical rate inputs with hourly mark OPEN modeling; not authenticated customer settlement or forward-known features.

limitations: All windows were historically observed; no independent OOS or profitability qualification.
5m OPEN reference is not executable bid/ask or verified5m futures mark.
Short window has12 complete daily returns and1 complete UTC week; annualization is descriptive and unstable.
Cash has undefined risk ratios when denominators are zero; BTC losing net contribution concentration is null, not zero diversification.
No risk module activation or new strategy/account run; current paper services are unchanged.
